Senior Digital Designer

King of the Rectangles

Full Time

Remote

Come join the team at ToyFight. We're a team of strategists, designers, developers and technologists with a passion for creating digital experiences for consumers and brands.

The Role

We’re looking for a talented Senior Digital Designer to join our team.

You’ll work across a broad range of projects, from websites and interactive experiences to digital products and campaigns. Working closely with our Creative Directors, developers and wider creative team, you’ll help shape ideas and turn them into considered, beautifully crafted digital experiences.

You’ll be comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial concepts and exploration through to detailed design and final delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Create thoughtful, original and beautifully crafted digital experiences.

  • Take ownership of design across projects, from initial concepts through to final delivery.

  • Work closely with our team to develop and refine creative ideas.

  • Collaborate with developers throughout the design and build process.

  • Present work clearly and confidently to both the team and clients.

  • Consider interaction, motion and behaviour as an integral part of the design process.

  • Contribute to maintaining and developing the studio’s design standards.

  • Stay informed about new tools, technologies and developments within digital design.

  • The confidence to take ownership of your work while being open to collaboration, feedback and direction.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate the thinking behind your work.

  • An enthusiasm for digital design and a genuine interest in continuing to develop your craft.

What You’ll Bring

  • Around 4+ years of digital design experience, ideally within an agency or studio environment.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent digital design, ideas and craft.

  • Excellent visual design, typography and layout skills.

  • A strong understanding of UX, interaction and responsive design.

  • A high level of attention to detail and a strong eye for what makes great design.

  • Excellent knowledge of Figma and contemporary digital design processes.

  • An understanding of motion, 3D, WebGL or creative development would be a plus. You don’t need to build these experiences yourself, but an understanding of their possibilities is important.

Why Join Us

  • Work on ambitious digital projects for a broad range of interesting brands.

  • The opportunity to experiment with new technologies, tools and approaches.

  • Work alongside an experienced team with a strong focus on ideas and craft.

  • Opportunities for training, conferences and continued professional development.

  • The tools and equipment you need to do your best work.

  • A culture built around collaboration, curiosity and high standards.

  • Competitive salary and benefits.

  • 4 Day Week 100:80:100

Location

Wherever you want.

Salary

£DOE

4 Day Working Week

The four-day week at ToyFight is our way of handing back a fifth of your life without taking a thing off the table. It runs on a simple ethos, all of your pay, four days of your time, none of the quality lost. The extra day is yours. Sleep in, see people, go and be a person. We didn't do it to seem generous, we did it because rested people make original work, and tired people make ordinary work.

Ordinary is the enemy.

Flexible Hours

Enjoy the ability to adjust your work hours, offering you control over your schedule and working the way you want. Helping you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Remote Working

We champion the art of remote working. Revel in the tranquility of your personal sanctuary, slippers and all.

Vacation

With a generous offering of 28 vacation days, we don't just urge you to take a break; we celebrate your adventures. This is your time to rest, to live and find time for yourself, family and friends.

Annual Bonuses

Our annual bonuses are not mere transactions (or bottles of booze); they are our way of saying thank you, a tangible testament to the value and impact of your work.

Personal Days

In addition to our generous standard leave you can enjoy additional personal days for those times when life requires your attention outside of work.

Choice of Subs

Select from a range of subscriptions as part of your employment package. These subs cover a wide range of interests from film, music, learning and much more tailored to your personal or professional interests.
